definitions.explanation: Wages paid on a weekly basis. Less common in Japan than monthly salaries, but used in some part-time and short-term arrangements, especially in retail and food service.

examples.japanese: このバイトは{週給|しゅうきゅう}{払|ばら}いだ。
{週給|しゅうきゅう}を{現金|げんきん}でもらう。
examples.english: I receive my weekly pay in cash.

examples.japanese: {週給|しゅうきゅう}は{生活費|せいかつひ}の{計画|けいかく}が{立|た}てやすいという{利点|りてん}がある。
examples.english: Weekly pay has the advantage of making it easier to plan living expenses.

notes:
Compound of {週|しゅう} (week) + {給|きゅう} (pay). Often appears in compounds like {週給制|しゅうきゅうせい} (weekly wage system).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {週給|しゅうきゅう}{払|ばら}い: weekly payment
- {週給|しゅうきゅう}{制|せい}: weekly wage system
- {週給|しゅうきゅう}を{受|う}け{取|と}る: to receive a weekly wage

RELATED WORDS:
- {月給|げっきゅう}: monthly salary — by far the most common arrangement in Japan
- {日給|にっきゅう}: daily wage
- {時給|じきゅう}: hourly wage
